title: Smoky Harees Eggplant Delight
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish blending the rich flavors of the Middle East with the smokiness of roasted eggplant. This recipe is a perfect representation of the cuisine's unique blend of spices and textures.
instructions: Toss the eggplant cubes with olive oil, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper in a bowl until they are evenly coated.
Spread the eggplant mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the eggplant is tender and lightly browned.
While the eggplant is roasting, cook the harees according to the package instructions.
Once the eggplant is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Add the roasted eggplant to the harees and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
